question: Was Liverpool Street to Bethnal Green ground for noise, and when?
norm_question: was liverpool street to bethnal green ground for noise and when

answer.text: In the Mayor's written answer to Question 2022/1791 (28 June 2022), Bethnal Green to Liverpool Street on the Central line is listed as having benefited from rail grinding to help reduce noise levels between December 2021 and May 2022.

verified_claims.text: In the Mayor's written answer to Question 2022/1791 (28 June 2022), the attached list of sections that benefited from rail grinding to help reduce noise levels between December 2021 and May 2022 includes Bethnal Green to Liverpool Street on the Central line.

citations.quote:
Answer
Date:
Tuesday 28 June 2022
Sections of the London Underground that have benefited from rail grinding to help reduce noise levels (December 2021-May 2022)
Bethnal Green to Liverpool Street

verified_claims.text: In the same attachment to Mayor's Question 2022/1791, neither Bethnal Green to Liverpool Street nor Liverpool Street to Bethnal Green appears on the provisional list of Central line sections planned for rail grinding between June 2022 and November 2022, where only Queensway to Lancaster Gate is listed.

citations.quote: Sections of the London Underground that will benefit from rail grinding to help reduce noise levels between June 2022-
November 2022 (N.B. This list is provisional and subject to change).
Queensway to Lancaster Gate

verified_claims.text: Separately from rail grinding, a 9 December 2022 letter from TfL Head of Track Duncan Weir to the Environment Committee listed Liverpool Street - Bethnal Green Eastbound on the Central line under deep Tube reconditioning works planned for financial year 2023/24.
